title: Sriracha large mug
text: Sriracha large mug. My husband is a huge Sriracha fan... so I purchased this mug and a collection of sriracha packets to put in it.  He takes them everywhere with him.  We aren't eating "out" right now (virus) but we do have takeout in the car or other outdoor options.  The mug is 19oz so it's large and big coffee in the morning is important to him.  Bright red sriracha color with logs and green handle.  You are not going to miss it in your cupboard.  Hahaha!  Great Christmas colors!
